data.title: Khon Kaen Geopark passes Unesco review
data.description: Khon Kaen Geopark has successfully passed a Unesco review process is on track to become Thailand’s third Unesco global geopark, pending final approval in April next year, according to Natural Resources and Environment Minister Suchart Chomklin.

data.title: When fake missions spiral beyond control
data.description: Netflix is going big with Overacting , an over-the-top comedy that cranks chaos up to 11, in true Thai fashion.

data.title: Chiang Mai temple chedi collapses
data.description: The top of a chedi crumbled and fell to the ground at Wat Mai Nong Hoi in Doi Lo district, Chiang Mai, on Tuesday morning, raising concerns over the stability of nearby structures.

data.title: Easy Money Group Unveils Year-End Strategy
data.description: Easy Money launches a major 3 million baht giveaway campaign, while Premium Gold Yaowarat offers gold prizes worth a total of 2 million baht, along with an additional 10,000 baht in financing per baht-weight of gold under its gold sale-and-redemption service. The two campaigns reflect the Group’s strategy to deliver greater value, expand liquidity options and give back to customers during the final months of the year.

data.title: Egyptian mummy portraits show antiquity’s piercing gaze
data.description: ROME - An elegant woman gazes out from her portrait with expressive eyes, a gilded wreath worn in her hair and a gentle, questioning look on her face.

data.title: Phuket launches new bus line from airport to Rawai beach
data.description: PHUKET - A new bus route has been added on the resort island to serve commuters and travellers between the airport and Rawai beach.

data.title: Activists’ acquittals in criminal defamation case hailed
data.description: The United Nations human rights body has welcomed a Thai Court of Appeal decision upholding the acquittal of three human rights activists in a long-running criminal defamation case brought by the Thammakaset poultry company.

data.title: Ex-beauty queen faces public fraud, money-laundering, computer crime probe
data.description: Police are investigating allegations of public fraud, money laundering and computer crime involving former Miss Thailand Panadda "Boom" Wongphudee, following a scandal over millions of baht spent by her Goodness Foundation. She appeared to place the blame on her husband.

data.title: University student 'saved' after B400K digital arrest scam
data.description: Police forced their way into a university student's room to warn her she was online to a scammer who had already cheated her out of 400,000 baht.

data.title: Michelin Unveils 2027 Bib Gourmand List as Thailand Drives Gastronomy Hub Ambitions
data.description: The 10th-anniversary guide features 151 affordable dining spots, reinforcing TAT’s national policy to position Thailand as a world-class gastronomy hub

data.title: King Charles's former horse Point of Law wins Melbourne Cup
data.description: MELBOURNE - Short-priced favourite Point of Law on Tuesday surged to victory at the Aus$10 million (US$7.2 million) Melbourne Cup, earning jockey Ethan Brown a debut win in Australia's "race that stops a nation".

data.title: Chinese soup dish malatang proves a hit in Japan
data.description: The Chinese soup dish malatang is gaining popularity in Japan, with specialty restaurants expanding beyond major metropolitan cities and spin-off products such as a malatang-themed game being offered.

data.title: Father fires gun at school, angry his child still unable to read
data.description: NAKHON RATCHASIMA - Students and parents fled in panic as an angry father went on a rampage at their school, firing gunshots into the air after complaining that his child could still not read or do basic maths.

data.title: Hong Kong to sentence activist Joshua Wong on Thursday
data.description: HONG KONG — A Hong Kong court will sentence pro-democracy activist Joshua Wong on Thursday, according to the judiciary's website, in a second national security trial that could see him jailed for life.

data.title: ONE Championship: Chatri eyes Haggerty vs Yod-IQ clash and bantamweight Grand Prix
data.description: Jonathan Haggerty could return to Muay Thai against Yod-IQ Or Pimolsri in 2027, with ONE Championship chairman and CEO Chatri Sityodtong also considering a bantamweight World Grand Prix.

data.title: US signals progress in Iran talks to avert flare-up
data.description: WASHINGTON — United States President Donald Trump signaled progress on Monday in talks with Iran to avoid a return to war, as Tehran reported "intensive" exchanges while offering to reopen the Strait of Hormuz under strict conditions.

data.title: Sealy Posturepedic launches the New "Elevate Collection"
data.description: On Friday, October 16, 2026, under the concept "Sense The Feeling". Sealy Posturepedic officially unveiled the latest collection at the Mattress Department, 4th Floor, Central Chidlom. Discover an elevated sleep experience driven by the standout Align Support ™ spring technology, engineered to provide more Sense & Respond with deep down contouring support.

data.title: Sea drone makers compete in Taiwan for soaring investment
data.description: TAINAN — Silver-hulled sea drones skim across the water as part of an exhibition in Taiwan where local and foreign companies are competing for a share of surging government investment in uncrewed vehicles to deter China.

data.title: 'Cursed' Peru town hopes Pope Leo brings better luck
data.description: CHICLAYO — A luckless Peruvian town that has for centuries been dismissed as cursed is hoping for a new lease on life when Pope Leo visits this month.

data.title: Mexican investigators raid storage unit rented by Thomas Markle
data.description: TIJUANA — Mexican authorities raided a storage unit rented by Meghan Markle's estranged father as part of an ongoing investigation into alleged child sex abuse material, the state prosecutor's office told Agence France-Presse ( AFP ) on Monday.

data.title: Trial of MLB players on pitch-rigging scandal opens
data.description: NEW YORK — The trial of two Major League Baseball (MLB) players accused of rigging pitches in a gambling scheme got under way in New York on Monday with jury selection.

data.title: Sri Trang Group Wins Two Prestigious Awards at SET Awards 2026
data.description: Sri Trang Group has marked another milestone in its sustainability journey at the SET Awards 2026, organized by the Stock Exchange of Thailand. Sri Trang Agro-Industry Public Company Limited, or STA, received the Highly Commended Supply Chain Management Award, while Sri Trang Gloves (Thailand) Public Company Limited, or STGT, received a Sustainability Recognition in the Sustainability Excellence category. These recognitions reflect the Group’s continued commitment to raising business standards and creating long-term value for stakeholders throughout the value chain.

data.title: Chopard opens a new boutique at ICONSIAM, Bangkok, Thailand
data.description: Bangkok, Thailand, October 29, 2026, Chopard is delighted to announce the opening of its newest boutique at ICONSIAM Shopping Center, one of Bangkok’s premier luxury lifestyle destinations. Marking another milestone in the Maison’s presence in Thailand, the new boutique offers an elegant and immersive retail experience, bringing together Chopard’s exceptional creations in watches and jewellery within a refined setting that reflects the Maison’s spirit of craftsmanship, creativity and Joie de Vivre.

data.title: Pyongyang blasts FBI allegations as it test-fires missiles
data.description: SEOUL - Pyongyang blasted on Monday the FBI's allegations it was behind the theft of US$6 billion from cryptocurrency platform Binance, as it test-fired strategic cruise missiles in a new display of its weapons capabilities.

data.title: The German Makkabi sports club where Muslims outnumber Jews
data.description: FRANKFURT — When they sweat it out at a big German sports club, Jewish, Muslim and other athletes are also sending a strong signal against rising antisemitism, the head of Makkabi Frankfurt told Agence France-Presse ( AFP ).

data.title: The 1 Exclusive unites Central Group and leading partners for ‘The 1 Exclusive Month of Moments
data.description: The 1 Exclusive, Central Group’s loyalty programme for the wealth segment, is bringing together businesses across the group and strategic partners Central The 1 Credit Card and Mastercard for “The 1 Exclusive Month of Moments”, a campaign offering members some of its most rewarding shopping privileges of the year throughout November 2026.

data.title: TOA wins two prestigious honours at SET Awards 2026 under Jatuphat’s leadership
data.description: TOA Paint (Thailand) Public Company Limited (TOA) has once again demonstrated its leadership vision and organizational excellence, reflecting its strong business performance, outstanding management capabilities and commitment to sustainable growth. The company announced a remarkable achievement at the SET Awards 2026, where Jatuphat Tangkaravakoon, Chief Executive Officer of TOA Paint (Thailand) Public Company Limited, received two prestigious honours under the Business Excellence category: the Best Company Performance Awards and the Outstanding CEO Awards.

data.title: US strategy links Myanmar peace talks to rare-earth access
data.description: WASHINGTON - Washington aims to use peace diplomacy in Myanmar as a way to expand US influence and potentially gain access to the country's rare-earth deposits, according to a recently published State Department strategy document.
